(Deut. XI. 13) And it shall happen if you listen carefully to My commandments which I command you today, to love the Lord your God and to serve Him with all your heart and with all your soul, that I will grant the rain of your land in its season, the former rain and the latter rain, so that you will gather in your corn, your wine and your oil. I will give grass to your field for your cattle, and you shall eat and be satisfied. Take care that your heart be not deceived and that you do not turn aside and serve strange gods and bow down before them. For then the wrath of the Lord will burn against you and He will close the heavens so that no rain shall fall and the earth shall not yield its produce, and you shall soon perish from the good land that the Lord is giving you. Lay these words of mine upon your heart and upon your soul, bind them as a sign upon your arm and let them be frontlets between your eyes. Teach them to your children by talking about them when you sit in your house and walk on the way and when you lie down and when you rise up. You shall write them upon the doorposts of your house and upon your gates, so that your days and the days of your children may increase upon the soil which the Lord has sworn to your fathers to give to them, as the days of the heavens above the earth.

(Numbers XV. 37) Thus spoke the Lord to Moses: Speak to the children of Israel and tell them to make themselves show-fringes upon the corners of their garments throughout their generations and to fasten to the fringe of each corner a thread of skyblue wool. They shall be show-fringes to you so that when you look upon them, you will remember all the

heading: Evening Prayer for the New Year

blocks.text: commandments of the Lord and fulfil them. And do not follow your heart and your eyes after which you go astray. Thus may you remember and fulfil all my commandments and be holy unto your God. I am the Lord your God who led you out of the land of Egypt in order to be your God. I am the Lord your God.

אמת All this is truth and faithfulness and it is established unto us that He, the Lord, is our God and there is none beside Him and we are Israel, His people. It is He who frees us from the hand of kings, our King who redeems us from the palm of all oppressors. It is God who requites our enemies on our behalf and pays retribution to all pursuers of our soul. It is He who performs unfathomable deeds of grandeur, wonders without number. He who sets our soul in the course of life and does not allow our feet to falter. He who leads us over the heights of our adversaries and raises our condition above all who hate us. It is He who effects wonders for us and revenge on Pharaoh, signs and miracles in the land of the sons of Ham, who slays all the first-born of Egypt in His wrath and leads His people Israel from their midst to eternal freedom. It is He who causes His children to pass between the divisions of the Red Sea, their persecutors and their enemies did He drown in the depths. His children saw His strength, they praised and acknowledged His Name, they willingly accepted His dominion over them. Moses and the children of Israel answered in song to Thee with great rejoicing and they all said:
מי Who is like Thee among the mighty, O Lord? Who is like Thee, glorious in holiness, awe-inspiring in fame, worker of wonder?
מלכותך Thy children saw Thy kingdom when Thou didst divide the sea before Moses: this is my God, they answered and said: The Lord shall reign for ever and ever.
ונאמר And it is said: For the Lord has freed Jacob and redeemed him from the hand of one stronger than he. Blessed art Thou, O Lord, who has redeemed Israel.
